profile.tagline: I design intelligent systems — from student ops automation to LLM agents and Flutter products.

about.summary: Software Engineer with 5 years of experience implementing automation projects. Worked as a consultant on Cash Application Automation for 2 years. A logical thinker who prioritizes real-world applications over textbook problem-solving — fail-first, fix-fast. Outside of work, stand-up comedy keeps the creative edge sharp. Always seeking new adventures, driven by wanderlust and a knack for discovering great food.

experience.description: Driving end-to-end automation of student onboarding, class allocation, attendance tracking, and parent-student communication using Make.com, Zapier, n8n, and Google Apps Script, with core CRM operations on Monday.com.

Flutter Developer at CDT Koraput (Coffee Mapper). AI Engineer at BeGig (custom LLM chatbot with RAG). Shopify Developer for Kunsquad. Software Developer for Nothing BOT Comedy (WhatsApp spot curation).

Built automation scenarios for manual business processes using Make, Zapier, Apps Script, and Zoho. Delivered end-to-end employee onboarding, appraisal, and offboarding systems; maintained and optimized automations for cost efficiency.

Built Apps Script Automation Projects (ASAP) tools for consultants — project management, team management, and faster data gathering. Earlier: Cash Application Automation for Bank of America clients (Zurich Insurance, CrediQ, Heritage Crystal Clean, Bureau Veritas).
